description: A thinking suffix on the model name: today's core removes it and sets generation_config.thinking_level; the new core refuses it.

exceptions.reason: Today's core turns a thinking suffix into generation_config.thinking_level through its thinking pipeline (field stripping, per-model level normalisation, budget-to-level conversion), which this core does not port for the Interactions API; it refuses the suffix with 400 and the client sets generation_config.thinking_level itself, which goes upstream as it came (thinking-level case).

error.message: a thinking suffix on the model name is not supported for the Interactions API; set generation_config.thinking_level instead

exceptions.reason: The suffix is refused; see client.status.
The suffix is refused before any upstream request; see client.status.
